logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-03 decision report: one wide figure, white background, sans-serif labels, navy #1B4F72 and green #117A65 accents.
Left panel, "Policy gates": two rounded boxes - "Quality gate: index at least 80" listing P1 87, P2 95, P3 97, P4 98, all pass; "Defect gate: raw count at most 5" listing P1 0, P2 0, P3 4, P4 2, all pass; an arrow to a green box "All four qualify: energy decides".
Right panel, "Measured Wh per fixed acceptance batch": horizontal bar chart on a linear 0-50 Wh axis with ticks at 0,10,20,30,40,50. Bars strictly to scale: P4 49, P1 28, P2 22, P3 10; value labels at bar ends, candidate labels left of axis. A dashed vertical reference line passes through the P3 bar end (10 Wh); double-headed gap arrows from that line to the P2, P1 and P4 bar ends labelled +12, +18 and +39 Wh. P3's bar is green with a small callout "lowest energy - recommended"; other bars muted navy-grey. Footer: "Single common test basis"; plus a note that cost, delivery, maintenance and reliability are unverified and excluded. All numbers must match the trusted table exactly; bars must be proportional to the axis, per the prior handover's mechanical-check requirement.
